totalJsBytes.source: Tripwire only, not the gate (growth vs main is, see growthToleranceBytes). Measured 6,352,583 B on the Bun minified build 2026-11-08 (main e25960f83); x 1.26 so a runaway still fails while main drift never blocks a PR. Replaces the 5 MB size-limit cap (plan Story 5.9, D7).

initialJsBytes.source: Absolute ceiling on what blocks first paint. Measured 1,394,644 B on the Bun minified build 2026-11-08 (main e25960f83); x 1.15. The tight check is the growth gate (<= 1 KB vs main).

largestChunkBytes.source: Absolute per-file ceiling for any chunk; the largest file is the entry (1,394,644 B on 2026-11-08), x 1.15. The tight check is the growth gate.

lazyChunkBytes.source: Absolute per-file ceiling for any chunk outside the initial closure. Largest is ghostty-web at 637,938 B on 2026-11-08 (embedded WASM); a lazy chunk past 1 MB should be split further.

maxWallMs.source: plan Story 5.5 / REQ-M1; measured about 1,100 ms warm on 2026-10-21; raised from 10000 to 30000 on 2026-10-28 after contended-host builds took 13-42 s, then to 90000 on 2026-10-29 after builds took 47-59 s at host load 130-235
